name: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan S.A.
summary: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan S.A. (EUC.WA) is dedicated to helping accident victims and their families claim financial settlements from insurance carriers. The company provides its services in Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, and Romania. Founded in 2004, its main office is situated in Legnica, Poland.
